description: This file defines a theming class `AppTheme` that centralizes color palette and theme configuration for a Flutter application. It provides a method to generate a light theme with customized color scheme and widget styles.

classes.name: AppTheme
classes.description: A utility class that provides centralized theme configuration and color palette for a Flutter application.

methods.name: light
methods.description: Returns a ThemeData object configured for a light theme with defined color scheme and styling for various UI components.
